title: 单主体、自营一般贸易的普通出口
requirement: 采购→收货→购进票→两批出运→报关结果→收汇与退税资料贯通；无虚构外部成功。

environment.identity: local OIDC issuer of the test (RS256, typ at+jwt, JWKS by discovery); no real identity provider

actors.config.reviewer: 配置与交易档案发布人（独立复核）
actors.cost.checker: 核价复核（核实、评估、冻结）

chain: BRC-001: the S3 chain (S3-12) and D1 §5 steps 1–11 to the verified supplier delivery of 120 PCS
observed: 采购→收货: PO PO-2026-00001 issued and confirmed; 120 PCS released by QLT; supplier.A's delivery of 120 PCS verified by purchaser
购进票: purchase invoice pin-01a1d2fe-e969-7415-a917-f1eaaa3ab4ab verified by tax.officer before the shipments, 120 PCS matched to commitment.1 L1–L4

两批出运: shipment.1 (L1 24 + L2 36) and shipment.2 (L3 12 + L4 48) released and confirmed from one delivery; shipped per line [24 36 12 48] = ordered; documents [CI-2026-00001 PL-2026-00001 CI-2026-00002 PL-2026-00002] issued with 0 differences, originals released

报关结果: lot.1 and lot.2 (480.00 USD, 60 PCS each, one item) released by customs' recorded receipts (original text, mapping v1, sequence 1); the S/C is bound; FUL's actual_departure stays unrecorded (CN-R07)

收汇: stmt.sales.1 480.00 = P1 288.00 (prepayment moved, D-4) + P2 192.00, stmt.sales.2 480.00 = P2; fund.p2a 192.00 and fund.p2b 480.00 applied; both receivables 0, exposure 672.00 → 0; payable 600.00 paid

退税资料: invoice line 1 (120 PCS) allocated as export_refund evidence 60 to lot.1's case and 60 to lot.2's case (balance 120/120, 0 available), both cases expected under export.tax r1 with no amount and no result; both bundles complete with declaration, invoice and the fund records labelled commercial_allocation (CN-R11)
贯通: order.1 closed (shipped 24/36/12/48 = ordered across two shipments); OrderClosed released the 672.00 reservation through STL's consumer; exposure 0
无虚构外部成功: no refund declared, approved or received (both cases expected, no result); customs' outcomes only as recorded receipts; receivables closed by recorded fund records only (receipt)
not_executed: China customs (single window): submissions and receipts are recorded manually by the documentation clerk (CN-M01); the receipts' original texts are synthetic
the tax authority: invoices are synthetic scans imported and verified by tax.officer; refund declarations, approvals and payments are recorded from synthetic evidence
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the carrier's, forwarder's and inspection agency's systems: bookings, B/Ls and reports are entered from EVD evidence
a real identity provider (the test's local OIDC issuer mints every token)
the user interface (中文操作 is outside the API repository)
